head: 075f1b5b8015e343f25b45d36ccff571cb39739b

source.ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/12608; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 901, 904 (forbid seed row 1919 not used); hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; the author removed _untouch and moved the touch after the capacity check later in the same pull request (merged as f8ece6e17f)

rationale: The change merges append_slots into allocate_slots and touches prefix-hit blocks before the capacity check, undoing the touch with a new _untouch when the request does not fit. untouch-lru-order (row 901) is required: true at head, since _untouch re-appends evictable blocks at the free queue's tail in chain order, against FreeKVCacheBlockQueue's documented LRU and tail-first eviction order, every step a waiting request fails to fit; a person raised it and the author removed _untouch in favour of counting evictable hits before touching (author-fix); rewritten in ocra's words, since the benchmark's paraphrase (move the blocks to the front) is not what the fix did. row-904 is dropped and its range becomes a forbid range: a running request's blocks, prefix hits included, are already in req_to_blocks, so the empty list is right, and upstream kept it (the merged code only made the argument default to None). The forbid seed (row 1919) asks for a shorter error message: style, which no reviewer is asked to report, and upstream adopted the wording, so it is not a forbid range.

expect.concern: When allocate_slots cannot fit a request, _untouch puts its evictable prefix-hit blocks back at the tail of the free queue in chain order, so a request that was never scheduled makes them look most recently used and has each chain's first block evicted before its tail, breaking the queue's LRU, tail-first eviction order and costing prefix-cache hits under memory pressure.

forbid.reason: Passing an empty list for a running request is right: its blocks, prefix hits included, are already in req_to_blocks, and looking computed blocks up again would count them twice.
